description: This file defines the GatewayConnectionController class responsible for managing connections to gateways, including discovery, TLS verification, and auto-connection logic within an iOS application. It handles network resolutions, TLS fingerprint probing, and maintains connection state, exposing various configuration and utility methods.

classes.name: GatewayTLSFingerprintProbe
classes.description: A helper class for probing TLS fingerprint by establishing a WebSocket connection and extracting the server's certificate fingerprint during the TLS handshake.
